Name: Jerimoth, Son of David
Summary: Jerimoth, son of David, was the father of Mahalath, one of Rehoboam's wives.
KeyStory: Rehoboam took Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife.
RelatedPeople: King David; Mahalath, Daughter of Jerimoth
LifeLesson: David's line continued through sons whose names appear only in a marriage record.
